question:
During a matrix-algebra investigation, a class uses two square arrays $A=\begin{bmatrix}1&2\\3&1\end{bmatrix}$ and $B=\begin{bmatrix}2&-1\\0&4\end{bmatrix}$. The students examine three different operations on the same pair of matrices. First, they scale every entry of $A$ by the scalar 3. Next, they combine $A$ and $B$ by adding corresponding entries. They then use row-by-column multiplication to obtain the product $AB$. Finally, the teacher asks them to perform a compound calculation in which $A$ and $B$ are first added and the resulting matrix is multiplied by $B$. The activity is intended to distinguish scalar multiplication, matrix addition and matrix multiplication clearly.

(a) Calculate $3A$.

(b) Calculate $A+B$.

(c) Find the product $AB$.

(d) Evaluate $(A+B)B$ and explain the sequence of matrix operations used.
explanation:
(a)
In scalar multiplication, every element of the matrix is multiplied by the scalar. Therefore, $3A=3\begin{bmatrix}1&2\\3&1\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}3&6\\9&3\end{bmatrix}$.

(b)
Since $A$ and $B$ have the same order, their sum is obtained by adding corresponding elements. Thus, $A+B=\begin{bmatrix}1+2&2-1\\3+0&1+4\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}3&1\\3&5\end{bmatrix}$.

(c)
Using row-by-column multiplication, $AB=\begin{bmatrix}1&2\\3&1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}2&-1\\0&4\end{bmatrix}$. Therefore, $AB=\begin{bmatrix}1(2)+2(0)&1(-1)+2(4)\\3(2)+1(0)&3(-1)+1(4)\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}2&7\\6&1\end{bmatrix}$.

(d)
From part (b), $A+B=\begin{bmatrix}3&1\\3&5\end{bmatrix}$. Therefore, $(A+B)B=\begin{bmatrix}3&1\\3&5\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}2&-1\\0&4\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}3(2)+1(0)&3(-1)+1(4)\\3(2)+5(0)&3(-1)+5(4)\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}6&1\\6&17\end{bmatrix}$. The required sequence is to perform the matrix addition $A+B$ first and then multiply the resulting matrix by $B$ using row-by-column multiplication.

options.B:
(a) $3A=\begin{bmatrix}3&6\\9&3\end{bmatrix}$.
(b) $A+B=\begin{bmatrix}3&1\\3&5\end{bmatrix}$.
(c) $AB=\begin{bmatrix}2&7\\6&1\end{bmatrix}$.
(d) $(A+B)B=\begin{bmatrix}6&1\\6&17\end{bmatrix}$; first add $A$ and $B$, then multiply the sum by $B$.
